condition: Kill the process before provider call
seam: engine parked after the plan gate; Engine.aclose as the kill
injected_fault: process closed while the run is parked after the plan gate and before the first module
expected_outcome: No reservation or provider interaction
actual_outcome: status running, budget turns 0, inflight None, zero create_message calls, no artifact, gate checkpoint present
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): succeeded once, every module executed once, turns == provider calls, no inflight, checkpoints deleted, audit chain intact

condition: Kill after reservation but before provider call
seam: Engine.crash_mid_provider_call_for_tests (fires after reserve_provider and before create_message)
injected_fault: SimulatedCrash in the loop's before_create hook with the in-flight digest persisted
expected_outcome: Resume resolves the reservation without duplicate spend
actual_outcome: in-flight digest persisted and never reconciled
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): failed AGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, zero further provider calls (unknown spend never retried)

condition: Kill during provider call
seam: FaultingHostControl raising SimulatedCrash from inside create_message
injected_fault: SimulatedCrash raised inside the provider call on the first module
expected_outcome: Resume never spends again when the prior request is unresolved
actual_outcome: one in-flight digest with unknown spend; a sibling module in the same superstep may already have failed the run closed
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): failed AGENT_BUDGET_EXCEEDED, one run.failed event, provider call count unchanged, in-flight digest retained as the record of the unknown, no node left running, checkpoints deleted

condition: Kill after provider response but before artifact commit
seam: RunStore.complete_node monkeypatched to raise SimulatedCrash once
injected_fault: SimulatedCrash after reconcile_provider and before the artifact transaction
expected_outcome: One valid artifact after recovery
actual_outcome: no artifact for the lost module, reservation reconciled (spend known)
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): succeeded once, one artifact per module, the lost module re-executed once, turns == provider calls

condition: Kill after artifact commit but before checkpoint write
seam: Engine.crash_in_commit_gap_for_tests
injected_fault: SimulatedCrash between the artifact commit and the checkpoint write for CP-0
expected_outcome: Reuse-first recovery yields one artifact, one charge, and one terminal event
actual_outcome: artifact committed with no checkpoint
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): exactly one CP-0 artifact, run.succeeded exactly once

condition: Kill during final validation
seam: Engine._verify_run_artifacts monkeypatched to raise SimulatedCrash once
injected_fault: SimulatedCrash inside the metered final re-validation
expected_outcome: No successful run commits past validation or budget ceilings
actual_outcome: status running, no terminal event, checkpoint present, validation time charged
post_restart_state: recover()+wait(): succeeded once, one run.succeeded, no extra provider spend, checkpoints deleted

condition: Kill during snapshot acceptance
seam: accept_snapshot audit callback raising inside the transaction; two-connection acceptance race
injected_fault: exception inside the acceptance transaction; concurrent acceptance on two PostgreSQL connections
expected_outcome: Run and case accepted pointers remain atomic
actual_outcome: rollback leaves both pointers null and no audit row; the race moves both pointers once with SNAPSHOT_AUTHORITY_CHANGED for the loser

condition: Kill during model build or workbook render
seam: worker claim left BUILDING; identity-bound worker fallbacks
injected_fault: worker killed after claiming a build (row BUILDING with no executor); crashing pass after a re-point; crashing export pass
expected_outcome: One retryable failed or queued job, never a false ready file
actual_outcome: before Task 12a the claimed row stayed BUILDING forever; now the next worker start requeues it (recover_builds) and a live pass never steals a claimed row
post_restart_state: worker restart: build READY exactly once with payload digest, recover_builds() then 0
status: PASS (defect fixed: worker startup requeues BUILDING rows)

condition: Kill during report render, freeze, or filing
seam: freeze job claim without publication; files published before record commit; filing transaction rollback
injected_fault: worker dies after claiming a render; exports published but the record commit is lost; conflict inside the filing transaction
expected_outcome: No partial frozen or filed record
actual_outcome: job RENDERING with no record; exports on disk with no record; frozen and thread transitions rolled back
post_restart_state: recover_freeze_jobs() requeues, the next pass publishes once; retry converges on one record

condition: Database unavailable before a write
seam: store.ingest raising OperationalError under the HTTP upload route
injected_fault: sqlalchemy OperationalError (connection refused) raised before the source transaction
expected_outcome: Typed failure and no partial filesystem mutation
actual_outcome: before Task 12a a bare 500; now 503 {code: STORE_UNAVAILABLE} with no driver text on the wire, no temporary vault object, no source row, no set, no audit row
post_restart_state: same bytes ingest once the store is back (201, set version 1)

condition: Database disconnect after write acknowledgement
seam: pg_terminate_backend on the writer's backends after a committed write
injected_fault: every backend of the writing store terminated after the freeze request and after the acceptance committed
expected_outcome: Idempotent retry resolves the committed state
actual_outcome: the dropped connection surfaces once as a driver error, the pool recovers, the retry returns the same freeze job; the acceptance retry is the typed RUN_NOT_READY with the committed snapshot in place

condition: Serialization failure or deadlock
seam: two independent PostgreSQL connections parked mid-transaction at the same statement
injected_fault: both writers pass their pre-read before either commits
expected_outcome: One winner or explicit retry, never divergent active state
actual_outcome: before Task 12a: raw IntegrityError (revision number, freeze thread, frozen id, event seq), lost budget update, two opinion heads, stale draft conflict; now one winner and one typed loser everywhere, audit chain intact
status: PASS (defect fixed: case advisory lock; run-row and budget-row locks)

condition: Two concurrent identical uploads
seam: two connections parked before INSERT INTO sources after both duplicate pre-checks passed
injected_fault: identical bytes from two connections (source route and intake pack)
expected_outcome: One active source identity and one source-set transition
actual_outcome: one active source, set version 1, one source.ingested audit row; the loser is the typed 'source content already active'; distinct uploads get versions 1 and 2 with the later set carrying both

condition: Upload and withdrawal interleave
seam: ingest parked at the set insert against a withdrawal parked at the source update; both release orders
injected_fault: upload and withdrawal of a different source interleaved on two connections; duplicate withdrawal
expected_outcome: A valid monotonic source-set history under both commit orders
actual_outcome: versions 1,2,3 with no gap or fork, final set holds exactly the live source; before Task 12a a duplicate withdrawal minted a second version and audit row, now it withdraws once

condition: Two workers claim one model job
seam: two connections parked at the claim UPDATE
injected_fault: both executors read QUEUED and race the compare-and-swap
expected_outcome: One executor wins and one exits without mutation
actual_outcome: one True and one False, the row BUILDING/RENDERING once; the loser computes nothing

condition: Two analysts sign the same model base
seam: two connections parked before INSERT INTO model_revisions (fresh case and existing head)
injected_fault: both sign-offs read the same head
expected_outcome: One revision wins and one receives a conflict
actual_outcome: before Task 12a the loser got a raw IntegrityError on the revision number; now ModelRevisionConflict naming the winner, one head, contiguous revision order, one audit row per revision

condition: Two approvers file the same digest
seam: two connections parked at the filing UPDATE
injected_fault: two approvers race the FROZEN->FILED compare-and-swap
expected_outcome: One filed object and one filing event
actual_outcome: one FILED record, one receipt naming the winner, one deliverable.filed audit row; the loser is None (RESUME_NOT_APPLIED at the service)

condition: Source withdraws during evidence read
seam: withdrawal between pin and read_evidence; withdrawal racing the injected read inside the tool
injected_fault: pinned source withdrawn while the run reads it
expected_outcome: The read or subsequent validation fails closed
actual_outcome: typed refusal with no text returned; the run fails closed
post_restart_state: recovery of a failed run appends nothing

condition: Source withdraws after run success but before acceptance
seam: withdrawal after run.succeeded and before accept
injected_fault: pinned source withdrawn between completion and acceptance
expected_outcome: Acceptance refuses or revalidates according to the pinned-source rule
actual_outcome: acceptance refused; the last pre-finalization withdrawal fails the run

condition: Membership changes during freeze or filing
seam: case membership deleted between the route's authorization and the governed commit
injected_fault: approver (filing) or analyst (freeze) standing revoked after the route check and before the transaction commits
expected_outcome: Commit-time authorization rejects stale authority
actual_outcome: before Task 12a the filing committed (200 FILED); now CASE_STANDING_REVOKED (403) inside the transaction, nothing filed, no receipt, no audit row, no freeze job
status: PASS (defect fixed: commit-time standing recheck under FOR SHARE)

condition: Vault byte changes after upload
seam: vault bytes replaced after ingest
injected_fault: stored source bytes or frozen content changed under their recorded digest
expected_outcome: Digest verification blocks every derived use
actual_outcome: re-use, read, acceptance and filing refuse typed

condition: Checkpoint file is absent, truncated, locked, or corrupt
seam: checkpoint file deleted, truncated or overwritten after kill-after-two-modules; exclusive OS lock held by another process
injected_fault: checkpoints.db removed; truncated to 512 bytes; overwritten with random bytes; lock file held by a second process
expected_outcome: Startup refuses or recovers without inventing progress
actual_outcome: absent: recover() re-admits from domain truth, finished modules relinked (execution count 1) and only the unfinished ones run; truncated/corrupt: recover() raises sqlite3.DatabaseError, readiness reports checkpointer false, status/events/artifacts unchanged, no provider contact; locked: INSTANCE_ALREADY_RUNNING before serving
post_restart_state: absent: succeeded once after recovery; damaged: unchanged until the operator restores the file

condition: Disk becomes full during vault or export write
seam: os.fsync raising ENOSPC under the vault put and the export publish
injected_fault: ENOSPC on the fsync of the temporary file
expected_outcome: No partial object is recorded as complete
actual_outcome: vault: no file (temporary unlinked), no source row, no set, retry succeeds; export: job FAILED DELIVERABLE_RENDER_FAILED, no frozen record, no export file, retry requeues and publishes

condition: Provider returns timeout, disconnect, 429, 500, 401, 403, 422, redirect, malformed usage, or malformed output
seam: FaultingHostControl raising the fault from create_message; scripted malformed usage and truncation
injected_fault: TimeoutError twice; ConnectionResetError; RuntimeError 429/500/307; PermissionError 401/403; ValueError 422; zero or malformed usage; max_tokens truncation
expected_outcome: Bounded retry policy and typed sanitized terminal outcome
actual_outcome: timeout: one byte-identical retry then AGENT_PROVIDER_TIMEOUT; every other transport or status failure: CANONICAL_GENERATION_FAILED after exactly one call; malformed usage/output: AGENT_OUTPUT_INVALID; the provider's message never persisted; terminal attempt recorded; checkpoints deleted

condition: Server-Sent Event connection drops and reconnects
seam: SSE tail re-read with Last-Event-ID; stream slot cap
injected_fault: client reconnects with the last delivered id; slots exhausted and released
expected_outcome: Missed events replay once and current state converges
actual_outcome: resume delivers exactly the events after the cursor; a terminal tail closes; slots are always returned

condition: Browser receives an older response after case or run switch
seam: workspace authority reducer generations
tests: caos/frontend/src/lib/workspaceAuthority.test.ts::rejects a previous-generation completion for the same case and run;caos/frontend/src/lib/workspaceAuthority.test.ts::rejects a stale failed request
injected_fault: a completion or failure from a previous authority generation arrives after a switch
expected_outcome: Authority generation discards the stale response
actual_outcome: stale completions and failures are rejected by the reducer

condition: Wall clock moves backward or forward

injected_fault: wall-clock timestamps out of order across a whole run
expected_outcome: Ordering and budget calculations remain valid through monotonic time
actual_outcome: events ordered by seq not by clock, run succeeded once, active time charged from the monotonic clock and never negative

condition: Enterprise identity provider or malware scanner is unavailable

expected_outcome: Protected work fails closed with an actionable status

condition: LibreOffice hangs or exits nonzero
